dog.description_text:
Taurus is an 8-month-old shepherd mix who weighs around 49 lbs and is an affectionate, playful goofball with a lot of personality. He has a particularly charming way of saying hello: flopping himself right into you like personal space is optional.

He loves people, does great with other dogs, and is always happy to be part of whatever is going on. He’s good on leash, and has some of the cutest zoomies you’ll ever see. Taurus is also a world-class lap melter. Sit on the floor and there’s a very good chance he’ll fold himself right into you for pets. He loves rope toys and is slowly figuring out the very important rules of tug-of-war.

As a young dog, Taurus will do best with an adopter who’s ready to keep him mentally and physically engaged as he grows. He’ll benefit from training, enrichment, play, and plenty of opportunities to use that busy brain, and he’ll repay the effort with affection, silliness, and an impressive commitment to being the goofiest guy in the room.

Registered adopters interested in Taurus can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
